verses: Saad! uss naseehat walay Quran ki qasam
Balkay)yeh kuffaar ghuroor o mukhalifat mein paray huye hain
Hum ney unn say pehlay bhi boht si ummaton ko tabah ker dala unhon ney her chand cheekh o pukar ki lekin woh waqt chutkaray ka na tha
Aur kafiron ko uss baat per tajjub hua kay unn hi mein say aik unhen daraney wala aagaya aur kehney lagay kay yeh to jadoogar aur jhoota hai
Kiya uss itnay saray maboodon ka aik hi mabood ker diya waqaee yeh boht hi ajeeb baat hai
Unn kay sardar yeh kehtay huye chalay kay chalo ji aur apney maboodon per jamay raho, yaqeenan uss baat mein to koi gharz hai
Hum ney to yeh baat pichlay deen mein bhi nahi suni, kuch nahi yeh to sirf gharant hai
Kiya hum sab mein say ussi per kalaam elahi nazil kiya gaya hai? Dar-asal yeh log meri wahee ki taraf say shak mein hain, balkay)yeh (sahih yeh hai kay) unhon ney abb tak mera azab chakha hi nahi
Ya kiya unn kay pass teray zabardast fayyaz rab ki rehmat kay khazaney hain
Ya kiya aasman o zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki her cheez ki badshahat unn hi ki hai, to phir yeh rasiyan taan ker charh jayen
Yeh bhi (baray baray) lashkaron mein say shikast paya hua (chota sa) lashkar hai
Unn say pehlay bhi qom Nooh aur aad aur meekhon walay Firaun ney jhutlaya tha
Aur samood ney aur qom Loot ney aur Aikah kay rehney walon ney bhi, yehi (baray) lashkar thay
Unn mein say aik bhi aisa na tha jiss ney rasoolon ki takzeeb na ki ho pus meri saza unn per sabit hogaee
Unhen sirf aik cheekh ka intizar hai jiss mein koi tawaquff (aur dheel) nahi hai
Aur unhon ney kaha kay aey humaray rab! humari sir-nawisht to humen roz hisab say pehlay hi dey dey
Aap unn ki baaton per sabar keren aur humaray banday Dawood (alaihi as-salam) ko yaad keren jo bari qooat wala tha, yaqeenan woh boht rujoo kerney wala tha
Hum ney paharon ko uss kay tabey ker rakha tha kay uss kay sath shaam ko aur subha ko tasbeeh khuwani keren
Aur parindon ko bhi jama ho ker sab kay sab uss kay zer farman rehtay
Aur hum ney uss ki saltanat ko mazboot ker diya tha aur ussay hikmat di thi aur baat ka faisla kerna
Aur kiya tujhay jhagra kerney walon ki (bhi) khabar mili? Jabkay woh deewar phaand ker mehrab mein aagaye

Jab yeh (hazrat) Dawood (alaihi as-salam) kay pass phonchay, pus yeh unn say darr gaye, unhon ney kaha khof na kijiye! hum do fareeq muqadma hain, hum mein say aik ney doosray per ziyadti ki hai, pus aap humaray darmiyan haq kay sath faisla ker dijiye aur insafi na kijiye aur humen seedhi raah bata dijiye

(suniyey) yeh mera bhai hai uss kay pass ninnanway dunbiyan hain aur meray pass aik hi dunbi hai lekin yeh mujh say keh raha hai kay apni yeh aik bhi mujh hi ko dey dey aur mujh per baat mein bari sakhti baratta hai

Aap ney farmaya! uss ka apni dunbiyon kay sath teri aik dunbi mila lenay ka sawal be-shak teray upper aik zulm hai aur aksar hissa daar aur shareek (aisay hi hotay hain kay) aik doosray per zulm kertay hain, siwaye unn kay jo eman laye aur jinhon ney nek amal kiye aur aisay log boht hi kum hain aur (hazrat) Dawood (alaihi as-salam) samajh gaye kay hum ney unhen aazmaya hai, phir to apney rab say istaghfaar kerney lagay aur aajzi kertay huye gir paray aur (poori tarah) rujoo kiya
Pus hum ney bhi unn ka woh (qusoor) moaf ker diya, yaqeenan woh humaray nazdeek baray martaba walay aur boht achay thikaney walay hain

Aey Dawood! hum ney tumhen zamin mein khalifa bana diya tum logon kay darmiyan haq kay sath faislay kero aur apni nafsani khuwahish ki pairwee na kero werna woh tumhen Allah ki raah say bhatka dey gi, yaqeenan jo log Allah ki raah say bhatak jatay hain unn kay liye sakht azab hai uss liye kay unhon ney hisab kay din ko bhala diya hai
Aur hum ney aasman o zamin aur unn kay darmiyan ki cheezon ko na-haq peda nahi kiya, yeh guman to kafiron ka hai so kafiron kay liye kharabi hai aag ki.
Kiya hum unn logon ko jo eman laye aur nek amal kiye unn kay barabar ker den gay jo (hamesha) zamin mein fasad machatay rahey, ya perhezgaron ko badkaron jaisa ker den?
Yeh ba-barkat kitab hai jissay hum ney aap ki taraf uss liye nazil farmaya hai kay log uss ki aayaton per ghor ghor-o-fiker keren aur aqalmand uss say naseehat hasil keren
Aur hum ney Dawood ko Sulaiman (naami farzand) ata farmaya, jo bara acha bandah tha aur bey hadd rujoo kerney wala tha
Jab unn kay samney shaam kay waqt tez roo khasay ghoray paish kiye gaye
To kehney lagay mein ney apney perwerdigar ki yaad per unn ghoron ki mohabbat ko tarjeeh di, yahan tak kay (aftab) chup gaya
Unn (ghoron) ko doobara meray samney lao! phir to pindliyon aur gardano per hath pherna shuroo ker diya
Aur hum ney Sulaiman (alaihi as-salam) ki aazmaeesh ki aur unn kay takht per aik jism daal diya phir uss ney rujoo kiya
Kaha kay aey meray rab! mujhay bakhsh dey aur mujhay aisa mulk ata farma jo meray siwa kissi (shakhs) kay laeeq na ho, to bara hi denay wala hai
Pus hum ney hua ko unn kay ma-tehat ker diya aur aap kay hukum say jahan aap chahatay narmi say phoncha diya kerti thi
Aur (taqat war) jinnat ko bhi (unn ka ma-tehat ker diya) her emaarat bananey walay ko aur ghota khor ko
Aur doosray jinnat ko bhi jo zanjeeron mein jakray rehtay
Yeh hai humara atiya abb to ehsan ker ya rok rakh, kuch hisab nahi
Unn kay liye humaray pass bara taqarrub hai aur boht acha thikana hai
Aur humaray banday Ayyub (alaihi as-salam) ka (bhi) zikar ker, jabkay uss ney apney rab ko pukara kay mujhay shetan ney ranj aur dukh phonchaya hai
Apna paon maaro, yeh nahaney ka thanda aur peenay ka pani hai
Aur hum ney ussay uss ka poora kunba ata farmaya balkay)yeh itna hi aur bhi ussi kay sath apni (khaas) rehmat say, aur aqalmandon ki naseehat kay liye

Aur apney hathon mein tinko ka aik mutha (jhaaro) ley ker maar dey aur qasam kay khilaf na ker, sach to yeh hai kay hum ney ussay bara sabir bandah paya, woh bara nek bandah tha aur bari hi raghbat rakhney wala
Humaray bandon Ibrahim, Ishaq aur Yaqoob (alaihim as-salam) ka bhi logon say zikar kero jo hathon aur aankhon walay thay
Hum ney unhen aik khaas baat yani aakhirat ki yaad kay sath makhsoos ker diya tha
Yeh sab humaray nazdeek bargazeedah aur behtareen log thay
Ismail, yasaa aur Zul-Kifl (alaihim as-salam) ka bhi zikar ker dijiye. Yeh sab behtareen log thay
Yeh naseehat hai aur yaqeen mano kay perhezgaron ki bari achi jagah hai
(yani hameshgi wali) jannaten jin kay darwazay unn kay liye khulay huye hain
Jin mein ba-faraghat takiey lagaye bethay huye tarah tarah kay meway aur qasam qasam ki sharabon ki farmaeeshen ker rahey hain
Aur unn kay pass neechi nazron wali hum umar hooren hun gi
Yeh hai jiss ka wada tum say hisab kay din kay liye kiya jata tha
Be-shak roziyan (khaas) humara atiya hain jin ka kabhi khatma hi nahi
Yeh to hui jaza, (yaad rakho kay) sirkashon kay liye bari buri jagah hai
Dozakh hai jiss mein woh jayen gay (aah) kiya hi bura bichona hai
Yeh hai, pus ussay chakhen, garum pani aur peep
Uss kay alawa aur tarah tarah kay azab
Yeh aik qom hai jo tumharay sath (aag mein) janey wali hai, koi khush aamdeed unn kay liye nahi hai yehi to jahannum mein janey walay hain
Woh kahen gay balkay)yeh tum hi ho jin kay liye koi khush aamdeed nahi hai tum hi ney to ussay pehlay hi say humaray samney laa rakha tha, pus rehney ki bari buri jagah hai
Woh kahen gay aey humaray rab! jiss ney (kufur ki rasam) humaray liye pehlay say nikali ho uss kay haq mein jahannum ki dugni saza ker dey
Aur jahannumi kahen gay kiya baat hai kay woh log humen dikhaee nahi detay jinhen hum buray logon mein shumar kertay thay
Kiya hum ney hi unn ka mazaq bana rakha tha ya humari nigahen unn say hatt gaee hain
Yaqeen jano kay dozakhiyon ka yeh jhagra zaroor hi hoga
Keh dijiye! kay mein to sirf khabardaar kerney wala hun aur ba-juz Allah wahid ghalib kay aur koi laeeq ibadat nahi
Jo perwerdigar hai aasmano ka aur zamin ka aur jo kuch unn kay darmiyan hai, woh zabardast aur bara bakhshney wala hai
Aap keh dijiye kay yeh boht bari khabar hai
Jiss say tum bey perwah ho rahey ho
Mujhay unn buland qadar farishton ki (baat cheet ka) koi ilm hi nahi jabkay woh takraar ker rahey thay
Meri taraf faqat yehi wahee ki jati hai kay mein to saaf saaf aagah ker denay wala hun
Jabkay aap kay rab ney farishton say irshad farmaya kay mein mitti say insan ko peda kerney wala hun
So jab mein ussay theek thaak ker loon aur uss mein apni rooh phoonk doon, to tum sab uss kay samney sajday mein gir parna
Chunacha tamam farishton ney sajdah kiya
Magar Iblees ney (na kiya), uss ney takabbur kiya aur woh tha kafiron mein say

(Allah Taalaa ney) farmaya aey Iblees! tujhay ussay sajdah kerney say kiss cheez ney roka jissay mein ney apney hathon say peda kiya. Kiya to kuch ghamand mein aagaya hai? Ya to baray darjay walon mein say hai
Uss ney jawab diya kay mein uss say behtar hun, tu ney mujhay aag say banaya, aur ussay mitti say banaya hai
Irshad hua kay to yahan say nikal jaa to mardood hua
Aur tujh per qayamat kay din tak meri laanat o phitkaar hai
Kehney laga meray rab mujhay logon kay uth kharay honey kay din tak mohlat dey
(Allah Taalaa ney) farmaya to mohlat walon mein say hai
Mutayyen waqt kay din tak
Kehney laga phir to teri izzat ki qasam! mein unn sab ko yaqeenan behka doon ga
Ba-juz teray unn bandon kay jo cheedah aur pasandeedah hun
Farmaya sach to yeh hai, aur mein sach hi kaha kerta hun
Kay tujh say aur teray tamam mannay walon say mein (bhi) jahannum ko bhar doon ga
Keh dijiye kay mein tum say uss per koi badla talab nahi kerta aur na mein takalluf kerney walon mein say hun
Yeh to tamam jahaan walon kay liye sirasir naseehat (o ibrat) hai
Yaqeenan tum uss ki haqeeqat ko kuch hi waqt kay baad (sahih tor per) jaan lo gay
